title: Now Thank We All Our God
description: Now Thank We All Our God in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 3 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Martin Rinkart, first published in 1636. The English translation is by Catherine Winkworth (1856). The tune, NUN DANKET, is by Johann Crüger (1647). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Now thank we all our God, with heart and hands and voi-ces, Who won-drous things has done, in Whom this world re-joi-ces; Who from our mo-thers' arms has blessed us on our way With count-less gifts of love, and still is ours to-day.

lines: Now thank we all our God,
with heart and hands and voices,
has blessed us on our way
through all our life be near us,
and blessed peace to cheer us;
And keep us in His grace,
And free us from all ills,
in this world and the next!
All praise and thanks to God
The Son and Him Who reigns
For thus it was, is now,

licence: Public domain. The Open Hymnal Project marks this hymn “copyright: public domain” (words, music and setting), and places its own editing, indexes and data files in the public domain.
credits: Melody and words from the Open Hymnal Project (openhymnal.org), edited by Brian J. Dumont; public domain.
reviewNotes: Held back: the score has no time signature (a chant or free rhythm), which the solfa grid cannot bar; bar 6 does not add up to 4 beats; bar 10 does not add up to 4 beats.
